title: markdown-index wikilink graph
description: The graph of wikilinks, inline tags, and front matter edges: every edge keyed by its content address, the same address EdgeCID computes. Identical edges share a content address and dedupe to a single entry.

wikilink.title: markdown-index wikilink
wikilink.description: One graph edge: a resolved wikilink, a body embed, an inline tag, or a front matter edge.

label.description: URL when a body wikilink target begins with a URL scheme (CommonMark absolute-URI scheme: 2–32 characters, then a colon), INTERNAL for every other body wikilink that resolves to a document, INTERNAL_MISSING if it does not resolve. A note title with a colon and a space stays INTERNAL or INTERNAL_MISSING. TAG is an inline #tag in the markdown body. Body embeds are separate: ![[target]] and ![](destination) are INTERNAL_ASSET or EXTERNAL_ASSET by the same URL-scheme rule, and a ![[target]] with no file extension or a .md extension is EMBEDDED_MARKDOWN if it resolves to a document, EMBEDDED_MARKDOWN_MISSING if it does not. FRONTMATTER_INTERNAL, FRONTMATTER_INTERNAL_MISSING, FRONTMATTER_URL, and FRONTMATTER_TAG are the same shapes found in a front matter string, including an inline markdown link; a front matter embed is not scanned and follows the plain wikilink or skipped-image rules. TAG and FRONTMATTER_TAG carry the text without # in both title and to_document_id, and neither resolves to a document UUID. A front matter tags list of bare words does not produce a label.

title.description: The pipe alias when the wikilink has one, otherwise the raw target text. For a markdown link, the link text. For an image embed, the alt text. For a TAG or FRONTMATTER_TAG edge, the tag text without the leading #.

from_document_id.description: UUID of the document holding the reference. Only documents with a non-empty UUID produce edges.

to_document_id.description: The target's UUID when a wikilink or an EMBEDDED_MARKDOWN embed resolves in the index, otherwise the raw target text. A markdown link and an asset embed keep their destination as written; assets are not indexed. For a TAG or FRONTMATTER_TAG edge, the tag text, not a document UUID.
